Two pieces of corn on the cob, each about 5 cm in diameter and 3-4 cm long. Including the cob, each piece weighs roughly 60-70 g, about 130 g total. The edible kernels are about 60% of that, around 80 g, which works out to roughly 75-90 kcal. Since mass is counted with the cob, I estimate about 85 kcal.
